svg.title: Information: eight layers come in, and no run is handed all of them
svg.desc: Eight information layers: market, filings, capital flow, news, macro and mood, quant and risk, book and FX, backtest. Critical sources have fallbacks tried in order: Hong Kong quotes from Tencent and Eastmoney, then stooq, then yfinance; US quotes from Nasdaq through six further routes; USD/HKD from Frankfurter, then exchangerate.host, then Yahoo. A source that fails is printed as not fetched, never as no news. A grid shows what each run is handed: the pre-open brief receives every kind of block in full, while session reports and intraday check-ins receive narrower cuts and no history. The model reads those files and does not fetch; code checks the result before anything is sent.

text.tspan: Eight layers come in. No run is handed all of them.
Code fetches, reconciles and decides what each run may read. The model reads; it does not fetch.
Critical sources fall back, in order
Nasdaq first, then six further routes
A source that fails says so
An empty fetch keeps the earlier value and says how old it is.
Old news is labelled apart from what is live.
a narrower cut: flagged names, or only when signals ask
The model reads these files and does not fetch. Code checks the result before anything is sent.
